What gets in the way today

Vendor insolvency risk

Onboarding critical suppliers who are in financial distress or close to insolvency.

Regulatory non-compliance

Contracting with vendors whose tax registration is inactive or whose filings are overdue.

Single-source dependency

No quick way to assess the financial capacity of backup suppliers.

How incoinfo fits your workflow

  1. 1

    Look up the vendor

    Search the prospective supplier by name or registration number.

  2. 2

    Check financial health

  3. 3

    Re-check the vendor any time in the next 12 months at no extra credit cost.

What your report includes

Every report also contains the standard sections: financials, directors, shareholding, charges, compliance and related companies.

Vendor health scorecard

Paid-up capital, net worth, operating cash flow and total debt.

Compliance status

Last annual return date, tax registration status and company status (active or in liquidation).

Management and address check

Registered address, company email and current directors.

Data from official company filings Secure payments Encrypted in transit

incoinfo compiles information from public and official sources, including company registry filings (in India, our current coverage: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Registrar of Companies), tax registrations and registered charge records. Reports are provided for reference and due diligence. They reflect each company’s filings up to its latest submission on record and are not investment, credit or legal advice. Verify material facts independently before acting on them.
